messages:
Taylor: Quick ops/clearance pass for the announce blog — target publish Thu 10am PST. Need owners for: final hero claim, benchmark stat copy, production screenshot from eng, webinar CTA and registration wiring, HubSpot list + UTMs, legal sign-off. Who can pick these up? :eyes:

Maya: I can take the hero + benchmark copy. Will drop two hero variants later today.

Jamal: I’ll own the webinar CTA + UTMs and the lead tag mapping to HubSpot. Suggest UTM pattern: `?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=announce_q2&utm_content={cta}`. OK?

Priya: I’ll wire the registration flow. Plan: form -> HubSpot form handler -> list "PL_Announce_Q2" -> sync to SFDC via smart-list. Need the exact form fields and any custom props (company_size, infra_type).

DesignBot: Mock uploaded: https://drive.redwood/designs/announce-hero-v3.png — also attached screenshot candidates (screenshot_v2.png). Recommend 1200x630 hero export.

Kris (Legal): Skimmed the draft — a couple nits. Change the line that reads "reduces inference cost by 60%" to "can reduce per-token inference cost by up to 60% in internal benchmarks". Please attach the benchmark methodology or a short caveat.

Maya: Noted Kris. Will add a short methodology blurb (2 lines) and append a footnote to the bench stat. Hero variants: 1) "High-throughput inference, predictable economics" 2) "Fast, reliable LLM serving that lowers inference costs" — which do we prefer for CTA A/B?

Taylor: I like variant 2 for paid promos, variant 1 for organic. Jamal — can you run A/B with variant in `utm_content`?

Jamal: Yep. I’ll set `utm_content=cta_a` and `cta_b`. Also mapping to HubSpot: add `lead_source=blog_announce` and `product_interest=inference_platform` hidden fields on the form.

Priya: For SFDC routing: leads with company_size>500 go to AE team A, else AE B. Also flag any leads requesting "dedicated" in product_interest for priority routing. Will add in the runbook.

DesignBot: Small CSS snippet for hero CTA spacing if helpful:

```
.hero-cta { margin-top: 24px; display:inline-block; }
```

Maya: Draft copy pushed to /content/drafts/announce_blog.md — pushing an update now with Kris's wording tweak and the bench caveat.

Kris (Legal): Thanks — will re-review once updated. Quick note: avoid the phrase "enterprise-grade" unless we can verify specific SLAs. Use "enterprise-ready" if needed.

Taylor: Good catch. Replace any SLA-y phrases. Also, one more ask: can we add a short 30-min webinar CTA slot on the top of the post — registration link should prefill email if possible. Jamal, Priya — can we support prefill?

Jamal: Yes — HubSpot allows prefill via query param `email=`. I’ll add `email` + `utm` params to the registration link.

Priya: Will ensure the form accepts `email` prefill and a hidden `orig_utm` field so we can trace. Also note the webinar timezone will be Tue 11am PT.

Taylor: Final checklist before publish: [ ] Hero variant locked, [ ] Bench caveat added, [ ] Design assets optimized, [ ] HubSpot form + hidden fields in place, [ ] UTMs set, [ ] Legal sign-off. Please react :white_check_mark: when your item is done so I can compile the publish queue.

Maya: Done for hero + bench (reacted). :white_check_mark:

DesignBot: Assets optimized and exported. :white_check_mark:

Jamal: UTMs and CTA links set, prefill tested. Pushed mapping to HubSpot. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Registration flow wired and SFDC routing added to runbook. :white_check_mark:

Kris (Legal): Final sign-off — approved with the bench caveat. :white_check_mark:

Taylor: Awesome — scheduling the post for Thu 10am PST. Thanks team! :tada:
